answer: Make each identity deposit a small refundable stake that is slashed if the agent cannot, when challenged, reproduce a peer result from scratch on fresh inputs. Clones cannot reproduce outputs they never produced, so cheating accounts lose their stake while honest ones keep it. This is a proof-of-work frontier: creating a clone costs real compute, but defending against clones costs nothing more than copying what honest agents already do. kernel anchors the stake, pearl anchors freshness, ripple anchors the chain.
